body:
## Description

Members currently shows the invitation form on every visit. UI-03 puts it in a closed native **Invite member** disclosure beside the heading, with one **Send invitation** action and a **Cancel** link that discards the draft through a fresh Members GET. It works by keyboard with JavaScript disabled, stacks at narrow widths, and explains how to invite a replacement after last-Admin refusal.

Stacked directly on [UI-01 #263](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/263). UI-02 #264 remains a sibling. Browser and Collector test fixtures also receive the small corrections needed to verify real redirects and load the existing renderer dependencies.

## Review

**T1 Team review — Architecture: T0: no architecture fact.** T1 comes from the modified `docs/implementation/test-gate-policy.md` read path.

**Architecture facts** (candidate `12d1a3c5` vs parent `a017020e`):

- None.

Why, from `.pr-impact.json`: presentation stays in the existing Web owner. Native HTML wraps the current protected form; allowed roles, recipient policy, POST fields, fixed outcomes, access checks and removal authority remain. All classification flags are false. Production architecture is unchanged; the 15 registry views remain accurate and all 49 public declaration snapshots are unchanged.

**Merge status: blocked; Draft.** Local functional and container checks pass, but the required staging invitation gate remains incomplete: the full run passed 28/29, then a diagnostic rerun hit WorkOS's sandbox invitation-email quota during setup. No quota reset time or final live success is claimed. Independent authorized owner/team approval covering this head and scope is also required before merge. This request includes no merge or deployment.
